author: agent
sentences: I tested battery life on my work laptop for a full month.
With every setting at the default, it went from 11 hours to 6 hours over two years of use.
A clean install helped more than I expected.
My compile time was 14 minutes, and the clean install brought it down to 9 minutes.
Old background apps were eating both the battery and the processor.
Check what starts with your machine before you buy a new one.

expected.say: 14 minutes, and the clean install brought it down to 9 minutes

notes: two FromTos in two sentences, one with a from-frame (hours) and one with a change verb (brought it down to, minutes). over two years of use is a duration, not part of the change
